name: Consiglio degli Anziani
note: collective government, no single ruler; infobox gives Anziani 1202–1312, lord Gherardo Appiani sold Pisa to Gian Galeazzo Visconti 1399, Gabriele Maria Visconti 1402–1406; occupied 1406 and annexed to the Republic of Florence; work list has Guido da Montefeltro (capitano)
